headline: Poonawalla Fincorp posts 407% jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Massive profit leap on business growth
summary: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a 407% year-on-year surge in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 375 crore. Net interest income grew 81%, while operating profit more than doubled during the quarter. The strong performance was driven by overall business growth, improving asset quality, and expansion in the gold loan network. Retail investors holding the stock benefit from surging profitability and operational expansion.

headline: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Net Profit Jumps Five-Fold to ₹375 Crore
hook: Sharp profit jump on strong lending growth
summary: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a net profit of ₹374.8 crore for Q2FY27, up from ₹74 crore a year ago, driven by a 75.7% rise in net interest income to ₹1,589 crore. Assets under management grew 75.6% year-on-year to ₹74,008 crore, alongside an improvement in asset quality as gross non-performing assets fell to 1.20%. For retail investors, the sharp earnings acceleration highlights strong growth in the NBFC sector.
